CustomField.description: Optional Portwood Brand this email-type record's wording override applies to. Blank means this record is the SHARED default for its Type__c, used by every brand (and by templates with no brand) that has not saved its own override — today's exact behavior, unchanged. When set, this record's Subject__c/Body_Html__c/etc. only apply to requests whose template's Brand__c matches (#369).
CustomField.label: Brand
